# update esbuild

Move the `esbuild` pin in the Go toolset over three releases at once, v0.8.34–v0.8.36; the release notes the author collected:

- https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.8.34
- https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.8.35
- https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.8.36

`esbuild` is a JS bundler kept in the Go toolset; the tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so a bump is a change of that pin. Bundling several upstream releases into one issue became the author's habit for this tool, which cut releases every few days.
